column1: # One row = one invocation. The harness runs each row against every corpus of a
# matching tier, hashes the outputs, and stores them under
# WHY A MATRIX AND NOT "run it once". PORTING.md Finding 12: --ont silently
# overrides an explicit --s. A preset that quietly resolves to the wrong numbers
# is invisible in output that agrees for other reasons, so every preset and every
# parameter that can change a decision gets its own row.
#   index cases run the indexing step alone.
#   align cases reuse the index built by the case named in "needs".
#   pipeline cases do both in one invocation.
# tier:   smoke | core | heavy   - the minimum corpus tier this case runs on.
# columns:  name  entry  tier  needs  args  notes
